set.body:
Outcome
Prevent stale ghost/menu appearance and retained window/subscription resources.

Owned scope
Dock.scala; DockRegion.scala; views.scala; drag.scala; theme/popout/tab-menu fixtures

Prerequisites
S2

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Specify and implement propagation or explicit dismissal/reopen policy for already-open ghost, context/overflow menu and tooltip surfaces.
- [ ] Apply public custom styles on the independent .dock ghost root and floating/header roots; preserve unrelated owner stylesheets.
- [ ] Switch light/dark and density during open overlays and window creation/restore; no visible surface keeps stale theme geometry or unresolved lookup colors.
- [ ] Close/dispose all owned transient UI and listeners when its dock/owner closes; repeated bind/switch/close cycles do not add stylesheet duplicates or live subscriptions.
- [ ] Document which host-created dialogs/popups require host registration; use public hooks rather than theme-specific scene traversal.

Required evidence
Computed-style probes, popup open/change/close cases, stylesheet/listener counts and owner-disposal tests.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
../meridianfx/PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code S3. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [S3] Define theme changes for live popups and dispose presentation bindings
